title: TokenMinds: Pretrained User Tokens and Embeddings for User Understanding in Large Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2606.25147v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: User modeling in industrial recommender systems typically produces dense embeddings, which suffer from representational constraints due to fixed-dimensional vectors. As an emerging alternative for discrete user representation, LLM-generated natural-language user profiles often capture language semantics rather than sequential patterns in user behaviors. Meanwhile, Semantic ID (SID) is effective for item representation, yet existing discrete user representations remain largely confined to quantizing already-pooled user vectors, clustering historical watches, or predicting coarse topic clusters solely for candidate retrieval. translated_title: TokenMinds：面向大型推荐系统用户理解的预训练用户Token与嵌入
translated_abstract: 工业推荐系统中的用户建模通常产生稠密嵌入，但由于固定维度向量的限制，其表征能力受到约束。作为离散用户表示的一种新兴替代方案，由LLM生成的自然语言用户画像往往捕获的是语言语义，而非用户行为中的序列模式。同时，语义ID（SID）虽然对物品表示很有效，但现有的离散用户表示大多仍局限于量化已池化的用户向量、对历史观看行为进行聚类，或仅为候选检索预测粗粒度的主题聚类。我们提出TokenMinds——一个将PLUM框架从基于SID的物品检索扩展到生成式序列用户建模的工业系统。TokenMinds构建于由预训练LLM改造而来的编码器-解码器架构之上，引入了双输出设计：编码器输出一种稠密用户嵌入，用于捕获……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TokenMinds基于预训练LLM改造的编码器-解码器架构并采用双输出设计，将PLUM框架从基于SID的物品检索扩展到生成式序列用户建模，同时产出稠密用户嵌入与离散用户Token，突破了固定维度稠密嵌入的表征限制并捕捉用户行为的序列模式。
en_tdlr: TokenMinds extends the PLUM framework from SID-based item retrieval to generative sequential user modeling, using an encoder-decoder architecture adapted from pretrained LLMs with a dual-output design that produces both dense user embeddings and discrete user tokens, overcoming the representational limits of fixed-dimensional embeddings and capturing sequential patterns in user behavior.
